title: New Beginnings
caption: I joined Sodel in May 2022. Within a couple of months, we moved into a rented co-sharing workplace as the office was getting renovated. And when we finally returned in Nov, the place looked absolutely amazing! A fresh start with a fresh vibe.

images.caption: The stunning new interior.
..and here's the lunch plate that made the renovation even better!

title: वज्रमूठ
caption: Taking inspiration from the Shiv Sena, NCP, and Congress 'Vajramuth' alliance, Sodel's own 'Vajramuth' was formed by Kiran Bavdane, Rohan Dubey, and Ajay Shelar. Unlike its political namesake, this Vajramuth was built on friendship, endless fun, and countless moments of office banter. These three have been the reason I've never felt bored at the office, making every workday more enjoyable with their company.

images.caption: 1. Rohan and Ajay convincing Kiran to be part of the gang.
2. Finally, the Vajramuth was formed!
3. The Strategy Team in action!

title: My Wedding
caption: One of the most memorable days of my life became even more special with the presence of my wonderful colleagues. Their heartfelt wishes turned our wedding celebration into an unforgettable occasion | https://surajpravindeshmukh.github.io/suraj-weds-komal/
